setup: A fixture repository has a reproducible calculation bug.
prompt: Разберись, почему итог считается неправильно. Пока ничего не меняй.

setup: The previous turn established the root cause and affected files.
prompt: Ок, исправь эту проблему.

setup: A small reproducible bug in a fixture.
prompt: Найди и исправь ошибку.
checks: Treat diagnosis as part of authorized implementation
Do not impose persistent investigation-only mode

setup: Login button label typo; focused rendering check passes. No authentication logic changes.
prompt: Исправь опечатку в кнопке входа.
checks: No unrelated security audit or broad test loop

setup: Source tests pass; packaged app has not been exercised. Agent can run a local smoke script.
prompt: Проверь, готово ли приложение к релизу.
checks: Distinguish source, built artifact and released behavior
Identify concrete remaining access or capability gaps

setup: A bounded code change in a fixture with collaboration available.
prompt: Исправь и затем запусти независимое ревью.
checks: Do not repeat successful checks without invalidation

setup: Standard docs: S027 done; S028/S029 planned; STATE.md owns status. Existing stack is fixed.
prompt: Убери S028 и S029 в бэклог, подготовь S030 для полировки текущей панели.
checks: Update affected scope, dependencies and criteria

setup: All remaining work is intentionally deferred by user.
prompt: Отложи оставшиеся слайсы, новых пока не добавляй.
checks: Record deferral without inventing a ready slice

setup: Conversation already identifies audience, problem, journey, MVP and intended use without contradictions.
prompt: Собери бриф из обсужденного.
checks: No redundant confirmation or new architecture

setup: Only an early product idea is supplied.
prompt: Хочу придумать приложение для подготовки к выступлениям.
checks: One main question about the largest uncertainty
No invented requirements or full questionnaire

setup: Read-only diagnosis; no accepted architecture decision; no per-task logging policy.
prompt: Объясни причину ошибки, без правок.

setup: Existing DECISIONS.md; user accepted an ownership-contract change.
prompt: Запиши это решение.

setup: Project explicitly requires one daily entry per task and permits documentation edits.
prompt: Исправь опечатку и запиши результат по нашему правилу.

setup: Collaboration available; one cohesive feature, agreed deliverable is one verified branch.
prompt: Используй $adhd-manager для этой одной задачи.
checks: One executor owns diagnosis, implementation and focused checks

setup: Two independent task branches must be combined into the agreed integration branch.
prompt: Объедини готовые задачи и проверь общий результат.
checks: Do not mark done from separate worker branches

setup: Runtime exposes a new frontier model, an everyday model and a fast model; a login copy edit and permission-enforcement change are separate tasks.
prompt: Подбери исполнителей в balanced режиме.
checks: Select supported models by runtime role
Risk follows behavior rather than filename
No mandatory xhigh for copy edit

setup: A fixture has a typo in a static button label; expose the skill catalog without loading this skill.
prompt: Fix the typo in this button label.
checks: Complete the local edit without invoking sviat-engineering
No architecture investigation or unrelated tests

setup: A brief specifies a personal task list, persistence, create/list/complete actions and first-version exclusions. Whether completed items stay visible is the only unresolved behavior.
prompt: Turn this brief into a small implementation plan.
checks: Ask only about the material missing behavior or label an appropriate assumption
Do not stop solely to recommend a separate discovery skill

setup: A fixture generated from documentation-model.md contains a ready label-change slice linking a large technical document with unrelated auth and deployment sections. Evaluate an implementation agent using that generated AGENTS.md, not the planning skill.
prompt: Implement the ready label-change slice.
checks: Read current state and selected slice
Use only relevant linked sections if needed
Complete and verify the scoped change without full document-stack reading

setup: A maintained Compact plan has one planned optional export slice and no dependent work.
prompt: Defer the export slice to the backlog.
checks: Update the existing status owner preserving useful scope
No new discovery or unrelated platform refresh
Report the deferral without an unrelated full-plan summary
